releaseNotes: Fractional Contributions Support — Members can now contribute fractional shares such as 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, etc.
Multi-Payout Monthly Committees — Monthly committees now support multiple payout disbursements per cycle (1 to N).
Enhanced Website & SEO — Comprehensive metadata, Open Graph cards, sitemap.xml, and structured schema data.
General stability improvements and ledger audit trail enhancements.
WhatsApp Multi-Tenancy & QR Connection Fix — Resolved indefinite spinner during session initialization.
Dual WhatsApp Pairing Support — Choose between Phone Number Pairing Code or QR Code scanning.
Session Status Monitoring — Bounded status polling and auto-recovery for WhatsApp session states.
General stability improvements and Edge Function integration fixes.
ROSCA cycle management — weekly, monthly, or custom contribution schedules.
Full member registry with phone number tracking.
Committee creation and complete lifecycle management.
Contribution tracking per cycle with payment status.
Payout management with cycle and date recording.
Branded PDF financial statements with one-tap sharing.
Optional WhatsApp receipt notifications via Evolution API.
